included.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare the token Combat Celebrant as an attacker choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creature you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
included.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Combat Celebrant.

template.name: Permanent Castable for {C}
template.scryfallQuery: mv<=1 (mana={0} or mana={1} or mana={C}) is:permanent

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C} {C}.
Cast the permanent that can be cast using {C} by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}. 
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the permanent cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If the permanent can be cast by paying {0}, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Restoration Angel.
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C} from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the nontoken permanent returned in step 2 by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C}.

feature.name: Put all Equipment cards from your library onto the battlefield

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Godo with haste.
The token Godo enters the battlefield, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Declare the token Godo as an attacker.
The token Godo triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Godo.

Proceed to your combat step.
Declare the Combat Celebrant copy as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

feature.name: Infinite tapped creature tokens until end of turn

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a non-legendary copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the untapped non-legendary Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat step 2.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Kiki-Jiki.

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare the Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Restoration Angel.
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Icewind Stalwart.
Repeat from step 2.

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of combat, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Port Razer with haste.
Declare the Port Razer token as an attacker.
When the Port Razer token deals combat damage, it triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get another combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Port Razer.
An opponent is unable to block Port Razer.

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Scourge of the Throne with haste.
Declare the Scourge of the Throne token as an attacker, attacking the opponent with the most life or an opponent that is tied for the most life.
The Scourge of the Throne token's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, giving the token +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at most five.
You have the lowest life total or are tied for the lowest life total.

almostIncluded.description:
Activate the mana dork by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare the token Combat Celebrant as an attacker and exert it, untapping all creatures you control and gaining an extra combat.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.easyPrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.

feature.name: Infinite untap of modified creatures you control

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Akki Battle Squad with haste.
Declare another modified creature you control as an attacker.
Akki Battle Squad triggers, untapping all modified creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
You control another modified creature that can attack this turn, and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Helm of the Host attached to Akki Battle Squad.

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Restoration Angel with haste.
When the Restoration Angel token enters, it triggers, blinking Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

Activate Combat Celebrant by tapping it, making a token copy of itself with haste.
Proceed to your combat step.
Declare the Combat Celebrant copy as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Combat Celebrant.
Combat Celebrant does not have summoning sickness.

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, Mirage Phalanx and Combat Celebrant each trigger.
Resolve the Mirage Phalanx trigger, creating a token copy of it with haste and without soulbond.
The Mirage Phalanx token enters the battlefield, triggering Mirage Phalanx's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Mirage Phalanx trigger, choosing not to pair it with the Mirage Phalanx token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger from step 1, creating a token copy of it with haste.
The Combat Celebrant token enters the battlefield, triggering Mirage Phalanx's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Mirage Phalanx trigger, choosing not to pair it with the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare the Combat Celebrant token as an attacker.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, allowing you to exert it to untap all other creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Mirage Phalanx is paired with Combat Celebrant.

When the Fear of Missing Out token enters, its first ability triggers, causing you to rummage.
Declare the token Fear of Missing Out as an attacker. It triggers, untapping another creature you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of the creature it is attached to with haste.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the token created in step 1, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Helm of the Host attached to any creature except the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.

almostIncluded.notes: This combo can deal twice as much damage if you pay Agate Instigator's offspring cost to control two of them.
almostIncluded.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
When the Pegasi enter, Agate Instigator triggers that many times, dealing that much damage to each opponent.

Go to combat, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the token copy of Timestream Navigator to take an extra turn.
Move to next turn.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Timestream Navigator.
You have the City's Blessing.

almostIncluded.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and Sandstorm Crasher as attackers, choosing to exert Sandstorm Crasher and Combat Celebrant as they attack. Combat Celebrant and Sandstorm Crasher each trigger.
Resolve the Sandstorm Crasher trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase using the Combat Celebrant token instead.
almostIncluded.easyPrerequisites: Sandstorm Crasher does not have summoning sickness.

feature.name: Opponents can't cast instant spells during their turns

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Azor with haste.
The Azor token enters the battlefield, preventing opponents from casting instants or sorceries during their next turn.
Repeat each turn.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Azor.

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice Second Chance and take an extra turn.
Attack with Sun Titan, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
You have 5 or less life.
Opponents can not kill Sun Titan when you attack.
Sun Titan does not have summoning sickness.

feature.name: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control

almostIncluded.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Holding priority, activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Palinchron trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate the nontoken Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Declare Mardu Siegebreaker as an attacker, triggering its second ability, creating at least one token copy of Restoration Angel that is tapped and attacking.
When the Restoration Angel token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, blinking Mardu Siegebreaker.
Mardu Siegebreaker leaves and enters the battlefield, causing the nontoken Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Restoration Angel and Mardu Siegebreaker's first ability.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling the nontoken Restoration Angel until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Mardu Siegebreaker.
Repeat from step 4.

feature.name: Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature token with haste

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Enduring Scalelord with haste.
Put a +1/+1 counter on either Enduring Scalelord.
The Enduring Scalelord who didn't have the counter put on it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat step 3.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Enduring Scalelord.
Helm of the Host attached to Enduring Scalelord.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Cast Restoration Angel.
Restoration Angel's ETB triggers, exiling itself and returning itself to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: Any creature type besides "Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size and remove all damage from all permanents.
Feast of Sanity triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to Illusory Ambusher and causing you to gain one life.
Illusory Ambusher triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 as necessary for each remaining trigger.
Once all triggers have been resolved, and all players pass priority, another cleanup step will occur, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size and remove all damage from all permanents.
Repeat from step 2.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
You control an effect that can increase Illusory Ambusher's toughness by at least one, or that can give Illusory Ambusher indestructible.
Your hand size is greater than seven, but less than seven plus Illusory Ambusher's toughness.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Restoration Angel with haste.
When the Restoration Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any non-Angel you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Restoration Angel token.
Repeat from step 2.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Restoration Angel.
You control at least one nontoken non-Angel creature with base power 4 or greater.
